message.content: In Blackjack, an Ace can be counted as either **1** or **11**, depending on which value gives the hand the best advantage without causing a bust. If counting an Ace as 11 would push the total over 21, it is automatically treated as 1. This flexibility allows hands like “soft” totals (e.g., Ace‑6 = 17) to be played differently from “hard” totals (e.g., Ace‑9 = 20).
